description: This PHP class 'HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute' is part of the HTMLPurifier library and implements functionality to convert relative URIs to absolute URIs by resolving base paths, handling special cases, and collapsing path segments. It is used for sanitizing and rewriting URIs to be absolute using the provided configuration and base URI.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_URIFilter_MakeAbsolute
classes.description: A class for converting relative URIs to absolute URIs within the HTMLPurifier framework.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration, setting the base URI and preparing the path stack.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Main method to rewrite relative URIs to absolute based on the base URI, handling special cases.

methods.name: _collapseStack
methods.description: Private method to resolve '.' and '..' segments within a URI path.
